#@ name: Gas and solar (example)
#@ description: One region, 2025-2050, 4 seasons x day / night. Domestic gas feeds a gas power plant; a solar PV plant and electricity imports complete the supply of an electricity demand growing 4 % a year. Two scenarios: SC_1 solar 20 % of the gas and solar output (user constraint), SC_2 a solar programme (minimum new solar capacity, 1 GW in 2025 growing 10 % a year to 2035).
